prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1412; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling straight through the intersection in Katy, Texas, when Driver 2 turned left across the path of Driver 1's vehicle and the two cars collided in the intersection. Driver 2 told the responding officer that the turn was made without seeing the oncoming vehicle, and the other driver confirmed that account at the scene. Independent witnesses gave statements consistent with the sequence of events, and several took photographs of the vehicles before they were moved. Those photographs show front-end damage to Driver 1's vehicle and right-side damage to Driver 2's vehicle, which is consistent with the angle and force of the impact described. Officers observed no prior damage of a different age or type on either vehicle. Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel when officers arrived, and a Passenger was also present in the vehicle, as confirmed by both witnesses and the other driver. Driver 1 reported pain in the right knee and was evaluated at the scene before being transported for further care. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
